customManagers.description: The Dockerfile's Node stage installs pnpm through corepack at the version of its PNPM_VERSION argument, which Renovate's Dockerfile manager does not read. This manager reads the argument under its renovate comment, so it moves with the mise.toml pin.

packageRules.description: pnpm is pinned twice, in mise.toml and in the Dockerfile's PNPM_VERSION. Both move in one pull request: internal/envsync's TestDockerfilePnpmMatchesMise fails when they differ, because the image must read the lockfile with the pnpm that wrote it.

TypeScript stays below 7 until typescript-eslint and vue-tsc support it: typescript-eslint rejects 7.0 at import and vue-tsc 3.x needs typescript/lib/tsc, which 7 no longer exports. Remove this rule when both release 7 support.
